notes: A chained git-lifecycle pipeline whose stages depend on each other in strict order: recover two branches from git bundles via HEAD/ref inspection, restore an off-branch stashed file onto feature-aurora and commit it, deploy each branch into an isolated directory that must not collide, sanitize a CI workflow (line-based, comment-aware, case-insensitive URL removal) in both a standalone and an in-repo copy, then stand up a bare repo served over SSH (dedicated OS user + authorized ed25519 key + running sshd) that must accept a clone AND a push. Every one of the five scaffolded competencies maps to a real deliverable and the reusable helpers (/app/bin/checkout.py, /app/bin/sanitize.py) are re-run on distinct hidden fixtures (fresh bundles with different branch names, and workflow files that probe comments-only/uppercase/edge URL placements), so generalization and malformed-input handling are exercised. The SSH component and the dependent fetch->recover->commit->deploy->sanitize->serve chain are why difficulty is hard (dependent_stages 3, tool_breadth 3, hidden_case_generalization 3, reasoning_depth 2, adversarial_inputs 2).
